title: Obtaining NK Cell Clones Using IL-2 and Gene-Modified K562 Cells
author: Maria A Streltsova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t6teren

It is possible to expand the panel of antibodies for staining and subsequent sorting of different NK cell subpopulations.

Irradiate feeder cells with γ radiation (100 Gy). Cells can be used immediately or frozen in 90% FCS (HyClone) containing 10% DMSO (Sigma) in a refrigerator (-150°C – -135°C) or in liquid nitrogen. Using non-irradiated feeder cells will result in the death of NK cells due to much faster proliferation of K562 cells and subsequent lack of nutrients in the medium. Therefore, if you are not sure about the quality of feeder cell irradiation, you can cultivate 5×10 5 K562-mbIL21 cells in cell culture flask for 3-5 days. The number of irradiated cells should not increase. Fetal calf serum HyClone Catalog #SH3007103 DMSO Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D1435

Add anti-CD56 and anti-CD3 monoclonal antibodies (and any other antibodies needed) according to the manufacturer's instructions into the experimental tube and control tubes. It is possible to expand the panel of antibodies for staining and subsequent sorting of different NK cell subpopulations.

steps.title: Prepare Separation Buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute 0.5% BSA (Serva) and 2 mM EDTA (Serva) in PBS, adjust pH to 7.2, sterilize by filtering through a 22-μm Millipore filter, and store at 4°C for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Prepare Feeder Cells and Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the feeder cells and the 96-well plates for sorting.

substeps.instruction: Cultivate K562mbIL-21 feeder cells in RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% FBS in 25cm² flasks at a concentration of 2-6×10^5 cells/ml to maintain log-phase growth.
Prepare warm AIM-V medium (Gibco) containing 100 unit/ml recombinant IL-2 (Sigma) and 10^4 irradiated feeder cells per ml.
Dispense 200 μl of this medium into the central 60 wells of a 96-well plate.
Dispense 200 μl of RPMI-1640 medium into the 36 marginal wells to minimize evaporation.
Warm the prepared plates in a CO2-incubator for a few hours prior to cell sorting.

steps.title: Initial PBMC Processing
steps.instruction: Resuspend PBMC in ice-cold separation buffer in a 15 or 50 ml Falcon™ tube and determine the cell number.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200×g for 10 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant by decanting or using an automatic pipette.

steps.title: Antibody Labeling
steps.instruction: Label the cells using the NK Cell Isolation Kit (Miltenyi Biotec Catalog #130-092-657) under sterile conditions, keeping cells cold.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 40 μl of separation buffer per 10^7 total cells and transfer to a new Falcon™ 15 ml polypropylene conical centrifuge tube.
Add 10 μl of NK Cell Biotin-Antibody Cocktail per 10^7 total cells, mix gently, and incubate for 5 min at 4°C.
Add 30 μl of separation buffer and 20 μl of NK Cell MicroBead Cocktail per 10^7 total cells, mix gently, and incubate for 10 min at 4°C.

steps.title: Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Perform negative magnetic separation using a MACS LD column (Miltenyi Biotech 130-042-901) and a MidiMACS Separator (Miltenyi Biotech 130-042-302).

substeps.instruction: Adjust the separation buffer volume to 500 μl per 10^8 total cells.
Install the MACS LD column into the MidiMACS Separator and rinse with 3 ml of separation buffer.
Place a new Falcon™ 15 ml polypropylene conical centrifuge tube under the column and apply the cell suspension.
Wash the column twice with 3 ml of separation buffer, adding buffer only when the reservoir is empty.
Collect the flow-through containing unlabeled NK cells, mix well, and determine the cell number.
Centrifuge the NK cells at 200×g for 10 min at 25°C and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μl of separation buffer per 5×10^6 total cells and transfer to a Falcon® 5mL round bottom polypropylene tube (Corning 352063).
Mix gently and incubate for 30 min on ice.
Add 1 ml of staining solution, centrifuge at 300×g for 4 min at 4°C, and decant the supernatant; repeat this process once more.
Resuspend the pellet in 300-500 μl of separation buffer per 5×10^6 total cells.

steps.title: Single Cell Sorting and Cultivation
steps.instruction: Sort and cultivate the NK cells to obtain clones.

substeps.instruction: Sort cells into the prepared 96-well plates using 'single cell' mode on a cell sorter (e.g., FACSVantage DiVa).
Cultivate the plates in a CO2-incubator for 2-3 weeks, ensuring plates are not moved or stirred.
After 2 weeks, visually assess clone growth via optical microscope; cells should be attached to the bottom in a circular clump in the center.
If growth is barely noticeable, return plates to the CO2-incubator for one additional week.
